newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX natgas called up amid firm power, gas prices.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX natgas called up amid firm power, gas prices.

text.p: NYMEX Henry Hub natgas futures were expected to open higher Wednesday in continuance of Tuesday's rally and firm cash prices, market sources said.
"It's because of electricity again," one trader said, noting power prices in the East Central Area Reliability Coordination Agreement (ECAR) were talked about $3-$4 higher.
Physical gas prices were similarly firm at $2.18-2.20 at the Henry Hub.
August over-the-counter trade ranged from $2.135 to $2.145 after settling to the upside Tuesday at $2.117 per million British thermal units.

Chart traders still pegged August support at $2.07 and then at the $2.051 low from July 8. Major trendline resistance was seen in the low-$2.20s, with further resistance pegged at the $2.29 and $2.36 prominent highs.

In Tuesday's cash, Gulf Coast quotes were steady to up slightly to the mid-teens. Midcon pipes moved a similar amount to $2.05-2.06. New York city gate gas was flat to down slightly in the high-$2.30s.
Injection estimates for today's weekly AGA storage report range from 55 to 90 bcf versus a 90 bcf build last year.
